rows.note: This is the all-purpose ordinal form for being second in rank or sequence, including a batting order when the context is clear.

example.english: I’m second in line to buy tickets.
example.jyutping: paai4 deoi6 maai5 fei1 ngo5 paai4 dai6 ji6

rows.note: Use this when explicitly saying that someone is the second person to perform an action, such as batting.

example.english: I was the second person to sing.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 dai6 ji6 go3 coeng3 go1 ge3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for ordinal number two and for being immediately below first in rank.

example.english: They came second in the competition.
example.jyutping: keoi5 lo2 zo2 dai6 ji6 ming4

rows.note: Use this when “second” means less important or subordinate rather than numerically ranked second.

example.english: These things come second; safety comes first.
example.traditional: 呢啲嘢係次要嘅，最緊要係安全。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 je5 hai6 ci3 jiu3 ge3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 on1 cyun4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unspecified short wait or moment, rather than the precise unit 秒.
Use this for the second item or person in a series when a specific noun is understood.
Use this for the precise unit of time, especially in measurements or timed instructions.

example.english: You have to finish this question in one second.
example.jyutping: ni1 tai4 jiu3 hai2 jat1 miu5 noi6 zou6 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for an additional helping or portion of food, rather than for an ordinal or time unit.

example.english: I’ve finished this portion and want a second helping.
example.traditional: 我食完呢份，想再要多一份。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 soeng2 zoi3 jiu3 do1 jat1 fan6
